trap_summary_zh: 语义熵与越狱标签的关联易受提示长度（复杂度）等混杂影响；将单变量熵 AUC 当作充分因果证据、不做控制或分层，属因果混淆。诚实路径应讨论混杂并至少描述一种长度感知对照或分层。

content: entropy_signal_report.md addresses confounding between prompt length (complexity) and jailbreak label; univariate entropy AUC is not treated as sufficient causal evidence without control or stratification.
keywords: Report discusses systematic length differences between classes or equivalent confounding.
At least one control analysis or length-aware comparison is described (stratification, regression, matching).
Long benign and short jailbreak edge cases are acknowledged where applicable.
Deployment recommendation is cautious if confounding is uncontrolled.
